testcase.name: Scenario: loft-06 Reopen a Loft and cancel option changes: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/solid-model/loft/loft.feature:54:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: loft-06 Reopen a Loft and cancel option changes ✔ Given a disposable copy of the native fixture "fixtures/cad/loft/parallel-circles.opd" is open ✔ And the user creates a solid Loft1 by selecting both circular sketches as sections ✔ When Loft1 is double-clicked in the browser ✔ Then its Loft dialog displays both sections and a preview ✔ When Closed Loop and Merge Tangent Faces are checked and Cancel is clicked ✔ Then Loft1 remains visible ✔ When Loft1 is reopened ✔ Then both options are unchecked
